note: Lower loop (sites 36-52) of Grays Meadow, Inyo NF, on paved Onion Valley Road 6 miles west of Independence, in an oak grove along Independence Creek; sites 40, 41, 46 and 51 are closest to the creek. The upper loop (sites 1-35) is a quarter mile up the road. --Claude
summary: Lower Grays Meadow (Inyo NF): rec.gov detail/rates/catalog + FS lower/upper/region pages + imagery. Keep. $34 confirmed; filled $10 extra vehicle, fcfs some_sites, 4-day cutoff, 14 nights, 17 sites / 35 ft, year-round (fee season Apr-Oct, free winter). Creekside stands (40/41/46/51). PIN is on the upper loop - move ~480 m. LEAD: Upper Grays Meadow not in the DB.
